source.filter: instrument_class = 'ordinary' AND mcap IS NOT NULL
source.rationale: ETFs, trusts (InvIT/REIT) and partly-paid special classes are not eligible for these indices; leaving them in the ranking pushes every ordinary stock down and breaks the band boundaries.

sources_rejected.index_constituents_monthly: Production's own source, but only 5 snapshots 2026-04-09 -> 2026-08-01. No history; would stamp 2026 membership on 2021-2023 books.
sources_rejected.local files: Swept during planning and empty: no dated ticker->bucket or ticker->rank file before 2026-04-09 anywhere in wm-research, wm-aiReports or the Friday Rebalance Automation tree.

monthly.construction: point-in-time mcap, last snapshot of each calendar month

semiannual.construction: NSE methodology: rank on mean full market cap over the 6 months ending 31-Jan / 31-Jul, effective end-March / end-September, held constant between.

cadences_built.why: 95.72% vs 89.50% agreement with production's own mcat on parent holdings, and it is the cadence the real indices actually follow.

ground_truth.caveat: mcat collapses Small+Micro+Unknown into SCAP, so this validates the three-bucket mapping only, never the Micro split.

coverage_on_parent_holdings.prior_approach_unknown_share: 12-33% of 2021-2023 holdings were unmappable under the 2026-snapshot approach the completed study used.

known_limitations: NSE buffer rules (incumbents retained near the boundary) are not modelled; this is most of the residual 4.3% disagreement with production.
Ranking uses full market cap, not free-float, and ignores the liquidity and listing-history eligibility filters NSE applies.

The Microcap band (ranks 501-750) is the weakest: of the 250 real Nifty Microcap 250 members on 2026-08-01, only 171 fall inside 501-750 and 62 rank beyond 750. Recall is 68% at best. Production folds Microcap into the Smallcap 250 signal so this never affects it -- but the micro_own arm depends on the split, and its classification error is materially larger than the other three buckets.
The four-bucket split is only testable over 2026, where real membership exists. Before 2026-04-09 there is no ground truth of any kind.
From 2026 the source turns daily; it is collapsed to month-end so the classification cadence is uniform across the window.
